content:
Yesterday, the summit on the challenges of the ONV within the French micronational world was held.
Summary of this summit:

Up to 18 participants

1 hour of conference


First, the ONV administration spoke about its challenges within the French micronational world.
It began with the introduction of the “Blue Sun Policy” to present a new image of the ONV in the French micronational sphere and to bury past tensions. Then, the continuation of international development, and finally, the creation of new institutions.

The ONV administration then answered questions from the audience.

It was a very instructive summit and also the very first ONV Summit.
The next summit will be the Asian Summit, which will take place on Saturday, August 30 at 12 PM (French time).
